import contextlib, hashlib, io, json, pathlib, runpy, signal, sys, unittest
method = "test_artifact_valid_and_rejection_matrix"
out = {"schema": 1, "target": "local-artifact-build-map-v1", "methods": [method], "result": "failed", "tests": 0, "failures": 0, "errors": 1, "skipped": 0, "fixture_cleanup": "unknown"}
def timeout(signum, frame):

try:
